name: skills
description: The open agent skills tool - npx skills
one_liner: A command-line tool that installs 'skills' (add-on abilities) into whichever AI coding assistant you use, working across dozens of different tools.
buyer: None specific for direct resale — this is developer infrastructure (a free CLI) rather than an end-customer product; the closest buyer is an AI tooling company wanting distribution for skills they publish.
business_use_cases: A design-systems company distributes their internal 'skill' (like design guidelines) to every engineer's AI assistant via one shared repo.
A skills marketplace or vendor uses it as the install mechanism, driving traffic and adoption of their own paid skills.
An agency standardizes every client project's AI-assistant setup by publishing an internal skills repo and asking new hires to run one command.

money_ideas.idea: Not directly monetizable as a fork — the opportunity is building and selling premium skills that install through this tool, not the installer itself.

steal_this: Publish a paid, high-quality niche skill (e.g. 'Shopify theme development' or 'HIPAA-compliant code review') distributed through this installer and market it directly to that niche.
